question.text: If $|z|=1$ and $z \neq \pm 1$, then all the points representing $\frac{z}{1-z^{2}}$ lie on;

options.text: a line not passing through the origin

solution.text:
Let $z=e^{i \theta}, \theta \neq \pm n \pi ~ n \in I$ Let $w=\frac{e^{i \theta}}{1-e^{i 2 \theta}}=\frac{1}{e^{-i \theta}-e^{i \theta}}=\frac{1}{-2 \cdot i \sin \theta}$
$\therefore$ Locus is y-axis
